banner.title: Cookies and privacy
banner.text: We use necessary cookies to make the site work. With your consent, we also measure statistics to improve AxaWeb. Marketing cookies are off by default.
banner.preferencesIntro: Choose which categories you allow. Necessary cookies are always active.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Required for basic functionality, security, and remembering your cookie choice. Always active.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: For optional functional settings that are not strictly necessary.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Helps us understand how the website is used via Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity. No marketing ads.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: For future marketing tools such as advertising pixels. Currently not loaded.

page.title: Cookie Policy | AxaWeb
page.description: Learn how AxaWeb uses cookies and similar technologies, which categories exist, and how you can change your consent.
page.intro: This cookie policy explains which cookies and similar technologies AxaWeb may use, why, and how you manage your choice.

what.title: What are cookies?
what.text: Cookies are small text files that your browser can store. Similar technologies, such as local storage, can serve the same purpose.

categories.title: Categories
categories.text: We distinguish between necessary cookies, preferences, statistics, and marketing. We only load optional statistics tools after your consent.

tools.title: Which tools may be used?
tools.text: Depending on your consent, the following tools may be loaded:
items: Necessary: storage of your cookie consent on this device.
Statistics: Google Analytics 4 (usage metrics) and Microsoft Clarity (session insights; form input masked), only after consent for Statistics.
Marketing: reserved for future tools; not loaded without marketing consent.
Preferences: reserved for optional functional settings.

manage.title: Managing consent
manage.text: You can accept, reject, or later change cookies via Cookie preferences in the footer. Without consent for Statistics or Marketing, those scripts are not loaded.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: You can read more about the processing of personal data in the privacy policy.
